
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| label: tbl-sec-endpoints
#| tbl-cap: "Secondary outcomes and their corresponding risk-factors. Note, that secondary endpoints are not specifically developed within the concept of empirically meaningful risk-factors as described by Mann et al. (2010) and Seto et al. (2003). Thus, secondary outcome partly only assess aspects of the broader and complex definition of risk-factors."
#| 
library(gt)
library(dplyr)

risk_factors_df <- data.frame(
    module = c(
        "Module 1 (Motivation)",
        "Module 1 (Motivation)",
        "Module 2 (Supervision and Social Relationships)",
        "Module 2 (Supervision and Social Relationships)",
        "Module 2 (Supervision and Social Relationships)",
        "Module 3 (Emotion Management)",
        "Module 3 (Emotion Management)",
        "Module 3 (Emotion Management)",
        "Module 3 (Emotion Management)",
        "Module 4 (Problem Solving)",
        "Module 5 (Offense-Supportive Attitudes)",
        "Module 6 (Sexuality Module)",
        "Module 6 (Sexuality Module)",
        "Module 6 (Sexuality Module)",
        "Module 6 (Sexuality Module)",
        "Module 6 (Sexuality Module)"
    ),
    risk_factor_endpoint = c(
        "Treatment readiness",
        "Motivation to change",
        "Negative social influences",
        "Resistance to rules and supervision",
        "Emotionally intimate relationships with adults",
        "(lifestyle) Impulsiveness",
        "Sexualized coping",
        "Impulse control difficulties",
        "External Coping",
        "Poor problem solving skills",
        "Offense-supportive attitudes",
        "Sexual interest in children",
        "Sexual interest in children",
        "Self-Efficacy for Modifying Sexual Interest",
        "Emotional congruence with children",
        "Sexual preoccupation"
    ),
    outcome_measure = c(
        "Corrections Victoria Treatment Readiness Questionnaire (CVTRQ)",
        "Readiness to Change Questionnaire (RCQ)",
        "Social Support Questionnaire (F-Soz-U)",
        "Optimized Questionnaire for the Measurement of Psychological Reactance (OQMPR)",
        "University of California Los Angeles Loneliness Scale (UCLA)",
        "Barratt Impulsiveness Scale-15 (BIS-15)",
        "Coping Using Sex Inventory (CUSI)",
        "Difficulties in Emotion Regulation Scale (DERS)",
        "Negative Affect Repair Questionnaire (NARQ)",
        "Social Problem-Solving Inventory Revised (SPSI-R)",
        "Bumby Molest Scale (BMS)",
        "The Explicit Sexual Interest Questionnaire (ESIQ)",
        "Sexual Outlet Inventory - Revised (SOI-R)",
        "Specific self-efficacy for modifying Sexual Interest in Children (SSIC)",
        "Questionnaire on Emotional Congruence with Children-Revised (EKK-R)",
        "Hyper-sexualBehavior Inventory-19 (HBI-19)"
    ),
    metric = c(
        "Total score",
        "Total score",
        "Total score",
        "Total score",
        "Total score",
        "Total score",
        "Total score",
        "Subscale Impulsivity ",
        "Subscale Externalized Coping",
        "Total score",
        "Total score",
        "Total score",
        "Total score",
        "Total score",
        "Total score",
        "Total score"
    )
)

tbl <- risk_factors_df %>%
    dplyr::select(module, outcome_measure, metric, risk_factor_endpoint) %>%
    gt(groupname_col = "module") %>%
    gt::cols_label(
        outcome_measure = md("**Secondary endpoint**"),
        metric = md("**Scale**"),
        risk_factor_endpoint = md("**Meaningful risk-factor**")
    ) %>%
    gt::fmt_markdown(
        columns = everything(),
        rows = everything()
    ) %>%
    gt::tab_style(
        style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
        locations = cells_row_groups()
    ) %>%
    gt:: tab_footnote(
        footnote = "Treatment readiness is not defined as a risk-factor in Seto et al. (2023) or Mann et al. (2010). Nevertheless, Treatment dropout is correleated with recidivism.",
        locations = cells_body(
        columns = risk_factor_endpoint,
        rows = risk_factor_endpoint == "Treatment readiness"
        )
    ) %>%
    gt:: tab_footnote(
        footnote = "Motivation to change is not defined as a risk-factor in Seto et al. (2023) or Mann et al. (2010). Nevertheless, Treatment dropout is correleated with recidivism.",
        locations = cells_body(
        columns = risk_factor_endpoint,
        rows = risk_factor_endpoint == "Motivation to change"
        )
    ) %>%
    gt::tab_options(
        table.font.size = 10,
        quarto.use_bootstrap = FALSE,
        quarto.disable_processing = TRUE,
        data_row.padding = px(1),
        summary_row.padding = gt::px(1),
        grand_summary_row.padding = gt::px(1),
        row_group.padding = gt::px(1)
    ) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(align = "left"), locations = cells_source_notes()) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(align = "left"), locations = cells_footnotes())

# save tbl as image
gt::gtsave(tbl, file = file.path(here::here("_tables/tbl-sec-endpoints.pdf")))
gt::gtsave(tbl, file = file.path(here::here("_tables/tbl-sec-endpoints.docx")))
gt::gtsave(tbl, file = file.path(here::here("_tables/tbl-sec-endpoints.png")))

tbl
```
